physics-e1-q1.prompt: Ndezvipi zvinotevera zvinoitika kana pole yekuchamhembe (N) neyekumaodzanyemba (S) yemagineti dzaswedera pedyo?
hints: Fungai zvinoitika kana mapole akasiyana emagineti asangana.
Pole N nepole S dzinodhonzana.
physics-e1-q1.explanation: Pakati pemapole akasiyana emagineti (N neS) pane simba rekudhonza (attraction), uye pakati pemapole akafanana pane simba rekudzvanyirana (repulsion).

physics-e1-q2.prompt: Paperewa mukombe wepurasitiki wakajeka makaiswa clip yesimbi, uye magineti yakaiswa kunze kwemukombe. Clip inoitwei kana magineti ichikwidzwa zvishoma nezvishoma?

options.d: Inotiza magineti ichienda kune rimwe divi

hints: Simba remagineti rinogona kupfuura purasitiki kana pepa zvitete.
Magineti kana ichifamba, clip inodhonzwawo.
physics-e1-q2.explanation: Simba remagineti (magnetic force) rinogona kupfuura zvinhu zvitete zvakaita sepurasitiki, pepa negirazi uye kushandira pazvinhu zvesimbi.

physics-e1-q3.prompt: Suho akaunganidza zvinhu zvakawanda kuti aone kuti ndezvipi zvinonamira pamagineti. Ndeapi mabviro ezvinhu anonamira zvakanaka pamagineti?
hints: Tsvakai zvinhu zvakagadzirwa nesimbi (iron).
Muti, rabha nepurasitiki hazvinamiri pamagineti.
physics-e1-q3.explanation: Msumari wesimbi ne clip zvakagadzirwa neiron, saka zvinonamira zvakanaka pamagineti. Muti, rabha, purasitiki negirazi hazvinamiri pamagineti.

physics-e1-q4.prompt: Ndeupi musimboti wesainzi unobatsira kuti musuo wefiriji wunhonge wega uchiita 'kutsi' wonamira zvakasimba pasina mukaha kana wavharwa?

options.a: Simba rekudhonza remagineti riri mukati merabha packing

hints: Mukati merabha yakapoterera musuo wefiriji mune chimwe chinhu.
Chinodhonza muviri wefiriji wesimbi nomusuo wacho.
physics-e1-q4.explanation: Mukati merabha packing yomusuo wefiriji mune bhandi remagineti rinonamira pamuviri wefiriji wesimbi, kuti mhepo inotonhora irege kubuda.

physics-e1-c.prompt: [Tsvakurudzo yepamusoro] Kana tikasunga bhari remagineti pakati nenyere tikaritungamidza padenga uye tikaritarisa risina kufamba, magineti inozungunuka kwechinguvana wozomira ichiratidza nzira imwe chete nguva dzose. Chikonzero chii?
hints: Zvakaenzana nenzira iyo compass inogara ichiratidza kuchamhembe nokumaodzanyemba.
Pasi patinogara ndegineti hombe ine pole yekuchamhembe neyekumaodzanyemba.
physics-e1-c.explanation: Pasi igineti hombe ine pole S pedyo nepole yekuchamhembe uye pole N pedyo nepole yekumaodzanyemba, saka pole N yemagineti inofamba zvakasununguka inoratidza kuchamhembe uye pole S inoratidza kumaodzanyemba.

physics-e1-q5.prompt: Kana bhari remagineti ratemwa pakati kuita zvikamu zviviri, magumo ezvikamu zvakatemwa anova sei?

options.b: Inoita magineti ine pole N chete neimwe ine pole S chete
options.c: Inorasikirwa nehunhu hwemagineti zvachose ikangova simbi
options.d: Zvikamu zvose zviviri zvinova nepole N chete

physics-e2-q3.explanation: Kana dhiramu yarohwa zvakasimba, kukura kwekudengenyeka (amplitude) kwegandarodhiramu kunowedzera, saka mbeu dzinorova kumusoro zvakanyanya uye ruzha runova rwakakura.

options.a: Nokuti kudengenyeka kwakabva musipikari kwakadengenyedza mhepo

hints: Dayaframu yesipikari inodengenyeka ichisundira nokudhonza mhepo yakaipoteredza.
Kudengenyeka kwemhepo kwakasvika pakenduru.
physics-e2-q4.explanation: Dayaframu yesipikari inodengenyeka ichidengenyedza mhepo, uye kudengenyeka kwemhepo uku (sound wave) kunosvika pamurazvo wekenduru ndokuuita kuti uzunguzike.

physics-e2-c.prompt: [Kufunga kwepamusoro] Wachi inorira yakaiswa mukati megirazi rakabviswa mhepo yose (vacuum), uye alamu yakarira. Nyere yewachi ichirova bhero asi hapana ruzha runonzwika. Chikonzero chii?

options.b: Nokuti mu vacuum ruzha runoshanduka kuita chiedza
options.c: Nokuti madziro egirazi akanwa ruzha rwose

hints: Kuti ruzha rusvike munzeve dzedu, rwunoda chinhu chekutamisa senge mhepo.
Mu vacuum hamuna mamolecule egasi.
physics-e2-c.explanation: Ruzha runotamiswa nokudengenyeka kwechinhu (medium) senge mhepo, saka mu vacuum isina mhepo ruzha harutamiswi.

physics-e2-q5.prompt: Kana uchirova xylophone, ndeupi musiyano wakarurama pakati peruzha rwekiyi pfupi nerwekiyi refu?

options.a: Kiyi inenge pfupi, inodengenyeka nokukurumidza uye inoita ruzha rwakakwirira
options.b: Kiyi inenge refu, inoita ruzha rwakakwirira
options.c: Kureba kwekiyi hakuna hukama neruzha rwakakwirira kana rwakadzika

hints: Chinhu chikapfupika uye chikatetepa, chinodengenyeka nokukurumidza muchipiri chimwe.
Kana frequency yakawanda, ruzha runova rwakakwirira.
physics-e2-q5.explanation: Kiyi kana yapfupika, kuwanda kwekudengenyeka pachipiri (frequency) kunowedzera, saka ruzha runova rwakakwirira; kana yareba, frequency inoderera uye ruzha runova rwakadzika.

physics-e3-q1.prompt: Mapepa matatu ane mukaha akaiswa achiteverana pamberi pechiedza chetochi. Mukaha inofanira kurongwa sei kuti chiedza chionekwe kune rimwe divi?

options.a: Mikaha mitatu inofanira kuenderana pamutsetse mumwe chete
options.b: Mikaha mitatu inofanira kuiswa zigzag, isina kuenderana
options.c: Panzvimbo pemukaha hapana basa, ingoiswa zvayo
options.d: Mukaha wepepa riri pakati unofanira kuvharwa netepi

hints: Chiedza hachigoni kutenderera nzira yakakombama.
Chiedza chine hunhu hwekufamba chakananga (rectilinear propagation).
physics-e3-q1.explanation: Chiedza chinofamba chakananga (rectilinear propagation of light), saka chinogona kupfuura mikaha yose chete kana mikaha mitatu iri pamutsetse mumwe chete.

physics-e3-q2.prompt: Tinoda kuti mumvuri wedoro rebheya pascreen ukure kupfuura zvawuri izvozvi. Nzira ipi yakakodzera?

options.c: Kudzosera tochi shure kure nedoro rebheya

hints: Chinhu chikaswedera pedyo nenzvimbo inobva chiedza, nzvimbo inovharira chiedza inoita yakakura.
Edzai kuswededza chinhu pedyo netochi.
physics-e3-q2.explanation: Kana kureba pakati pesosi yechiedza (tochi) nechinhu kuchiderera, kona inovharwa nechinhu inowedzera, saka mumvuri unoonekwa pascreen unokura.

physics-e3-q3.prompt: Tochi yakavheneka pazvinhu zvitatu (girazi rakajeka, pepa remafuta, nepepa rakakora dema), ndokuona mimvuri pawo pamadziro. Chinhu chipi chinoita mumvuri wakasviba uye wakajeka zvikuru?
hints: Tsvakai chinhu chisingabvumidze chiedza kupfuura zvachose (opaque).
Girazi rinopfuudza chiedza chakawanda, saka hariiti mumvuri.
physics-e3-q3.explanation: Pepa rakakora dema ichinhu chisingapfuudze chiedza (opaque), saka chiedza chinovharwa zvachose uye mumvuri unova wakasviba zvikuru.

physics-e3-q4.prompt: Pazuva rakajeka, mumvuri wembozha yemureza paDanga rechikoro wakaonekwa uchireba kwazvo mangwanani nemanheru, uye uchipfupika kwazvo masikati ne12. Chikonzero chii?

options.a: Nokuti kukwirira kwezuva (solar altitude) kunova kukuru kwazvo masikati ne12
options.b: Nokuti masikati kumhanya kwechiedza chezuva kunowedzera
options.d: Nokuti mhepo inofuridza mumvuri ichiusundira kure

hints: Fananidzai kana zuva riri pamusoro pemusoro nekana richivhenekera zvakakombama.
Kana kukwirira kwezuva kuri kukuru, mumvuri unopfupika.
physics-e3-q4.explanation: Kana kukwirira kwezuva kuri kukuru, chiedza chinodzika chakananga uye mumvuri unopfupika; mangwanani nemanheru, kukwirira kwezuva kuri kuchembere saka chiedza chinodzika chakakombama uye mumvuri unoreba.

physics-e3-c.prompt: [Tsvakurudzo yepamusoro] Bhokisi rakabaiwa mukaha mudiki pamberi uye pepa rinopfuudza chiedza zvishoma rakaiswa shure ('pinhole camera'). Kenduru yakatariswa, uye mufananidzo wayo wakaonekwa wakadzoserwa kumusoro-pasi nekuruboshwe-kurudyi. Chikonzero chikuru chii?

options.a: Nokuti chiedza chinobva kumusoro nepasi pekenduru chinofamba chakananga chichipfuura mukaha
options.b: Nokuti chiedza chinoreflect mukati mekabhokisi chikakombama

hints: Chiedza chinobva kumusoro kwekenduru chinofamba chakananga chichipfuura mukaha chosvika pasi pescreen.
Dhirowai mitsetse yenzira dzechiedza chinofamba chakananga.
physics-e3-c.explanation: Chiedza chinobva kumusoro kwechinhu chinofamba chakananga chichipfuura mukaha chosvika pasi pepepa, uye chiedza chinobva pasi chinosvika kumusoro, saka mufananidzo unoitika wakadzoserwa.

physics-e3-q5.prompt: Mukamuri rakasviba, tochi yakavheneka pagirazi rakatsetseka rakati nzvi. Chiedza chinoitei?

options.a: Chiedza chinorova pagirazi chodzoka kune rimwe divi (reflection)
options.c: Chiedza chinopfuura nemugirazi chofamba chakananga kuenda kumadziro ari kure
options.d: Chiedza chinoparadzaniswa kuita mavara kuita murarabungu

hints: Girazi rine hunhu hwekudzosera chiedza sezvarakaita.
Kona yekupinda (incident angle) neyekudzoka (reflection angle) dzakaenzana.
physics-e3-q5.explanation: Kana chiedza chichifamba chakananga chikasangana nepamusoro patsetseka senge girazi, chinoshandura nzira chodzoka, uye izvi zvinonzi 'reflection of light'.

physics-e4-q1.prompt: Chizito chinorema 20 g chakasungirirwa panzvimbo ina dzakaenzana kuruboshwe kubva pafulcrum yebharanzi. Chizito chinofanira kusungirirwa kurudyi panzvimbo mbiri kubva pafulcrum kuti pave nebharanzi chinorema marii?
hints: Verengai (kureba kuruboshwe × huremu) = (kureba kurudyi × huremu).
Kuruboshwe ndi 4 × 20 = 80, saka kurudyi 2 × (?) = 80.
physics-e4-q1.explanation: Maererano nomusimboti webharanzi, moment yekuruboshwe ($4\text{ nzvimbo} \times 20\text{ g} = 80$) inofanira kuenzana nemoment yekurudyi ($2\text{ nzvimbo} \times ? = 80$), saka chizito che $40\text{ g}$ chinofanira kusungirirwa.

physics-e4-q2.prompt: Mukoma anorema 40 kg nomunin'ina anorema 20 kg vari kutamba seesaw. Vanofanira kugara sei kuti vave nebharanzi vachifara?

options.a: Mukoma anogara pedyo nefulcrum kupfuura munin'ina
options.b: Mukoma anogara kure nefulcrum kupfuura munin'ina
options.c: Vose vaviri vanogara pamucheto wakaenzana weseesaw
options.d: Mukoma nomunin'ina vanogara vakaisana pamusoro pefulcrum

hints: Divi rinorema rinodzika.
Kureba kwedivi rinorema kunofanira kuderedzwa kuti (huremu × kureba) zvienzane.
physics-e4-q2.explanation: Mukoma anorema ($40\text{ kg}$) anofanira kugara padyo nefulcrum nehafu yekureba kwemunin'ina anorema zvishoma ($20\text{ kg}$) kuti vave nebharanzi.

physics-e4-q3.prompt: Mukuedza kwekuwana bharanzi, zvizito zviviri zve10 g zvakasungirirwa panzvimbo nhatu kuruboshwe kwefulcrum. Zvizito zve10 g zvakawanda sei zvinodiwa panzvimbo imwe kurudyi kuti pave nebharanzi?
hints: Huremu hwose kuruboshwe i20 g uye kureba kunzvimbo nhatu (3 × 20 = 60).
Kurudyi kureba kwenzvimbo imwe, saka huremu hunofanira kuva 60 g (zvizito zvitanhatu).
physics-e4-q3.explanation: Mhedzisiro yesimba kuruboshwe ndi $3 \times 20\text{ g} = 60$. Kureba kurudyi kuri $1\text{ nzvimbo}$, saka huremu hunodiwa ndi $60\text{ g}$, zvichireva zvizito zve $10\text{ g}$ zvinosvika $6$.

physics-e4-q4.prompt: Kana uchibvisa msumari wakarohwa zvakasimba pabhodhi nesando yekubvisa nzara (claw hammer), kubata kumucheto wemubato kunoda simba duku kupfuura kubata pakati. Chikonzero chesainzi chii?

options.a: Nokuti kureba kubva pafulcrum (musoro wesando wakakombama) kuenda panzvimbo yesimba (mubato) kunowedzera
options.b: Nokuti huremu hwemsumari hunova hwuchiri hwakareruka pakarepo

hints: Fungai nezvomusimboti we lever.
Kana kureba pakati pefulcrum nenzvimbo yesimba kuri kukuru, simba duku rinogona kuita simba guru.
physics-e4-q4.explanation: Mu lever, kureba kubva pafulcrum kuenda panzvimbo yesimba kana kuchiwedzera, simba duku rinogona kutamisa simba guru panzvimbo yekushanda (load), saka msumari unobviswa nyore.

physics-e4-c.prompt: [Kufunga kwepamusoro] Kana uchibudisa dombo rakakura nelever uchiisa fulcrum padyo nedombo (load), simba rekudzvanya rechanza rinoderera, asi kureba kunofanira kufamba nechanza kunoshanduka sei?

options.d: Dombo rinosimuka rega pasina kufambisa chanza

hints: Kana uchiwana mukana pasimba, unorasikirwa pakureba kwekufamba.
Izvi zvinonzi 'musimboti wemushando (work principle)' mu physics.
physics-e4-c.explanation: Kushandisa lever kunogona kuderedza huwandu hwesimba, asi kureba kunofanira kufamba nechanza kunowedzera sezvazvakaita, saka huwandu hwemushando wose hunochengetwa (work principle).

physics-e4-q5.prompt: Chii chinoita kuti kutamisa mutoro unorema kunoda simba duku zvikuru paunenge wuchiiswa mugoridhe rine mavhiri kupfuura kuukweva pasi?

options.a: Nokuti mavhiri anoreva ('rolling friction') yepamusoro inova duku zvikuru kupfuura sliding friction
options.b: Nokuti mavhiri anoderedza huremu hwemutoro ku 1/10
options.c: Nokuti gravity yePasi inoparara pamusoro pemavhiri

hints: Fananidzai friction inoitika kana chinhu chichidhonzwa nenguva iyo mavhiri achitenderera.
Rolling friction yemavhiri idiki zvikuru.
physics-e4-q5.explanation: Kana mavhiri akashandiswa, sliding friction pakati pepasi nechinhu inoshanduka kuita rolling friction diki zvikuru, saka simba re friction rinodzivirira kufamba rinoderera zvikuru.

physics-e5-q1.prompt: Ndechipi chirevo chesainzi chakarurama chekuenzanisa kumhanya (speed) kwezvinhu?

options.a: Kana vachimhanya mudaro rimwe chete, nguva shoma inoreva speed yakakura
options.b: Kana vachimhanya nguva imwe chete, kureba kwekufamba kuchipfupika, speed inova yakakura
options.c: Speed ndiyo nguva yatorwa yakakamurwa nokureba kwekufamba
options.d: Kana chinhu chinorema, speed inogara yakaenzana nguva dzose

hints: Mumujaho wekumhanya, mukwikwidzi wekutanga ndiye anotora nguva pfupi kusvika pamutsara wekupedzisira.
Speed = kureba kwekufamba ÷ nguva yakatorwa
physics-e5-q1.explanation: Kana mukufamba kwakafanana, nguva shoma inoreva kumhanya kwakakura; kana nguva yakafanana, kureba kwekufamba kuchikura, speed inova yakakura.

physics-e5-q2.prompt: Kana uchironga kuedza kwakanaka kwekuenzanisa speed yebhora resimbi rinodonha mugwenga rine mativi akasiyana, ndechipi chisiri 'chimiro chinofanira kuramba chakaenzana (controlled variable)'?

options.b: Kukwirira kwekutanga kunotangirwa kudonha kwebhora resimbi

hints: Tsvakai chimiro chatinoshandura kuti tiwane (independent variable).
Kuti tione speed maererano nekona, kona inofanira kusiyana.
physics-e5-q2.explanation: Nokuti tiri kuongorora speed maererano nekona yegwenga, kona yegwenga ndiyo 'manipulated variable' inofanira kushandurwa, uye zvimwe zvose zvinofanira kuramba zvakaenzana.

physics-e5-q3.prompt: Mumujaho wemamita 100, nguva dzevakwikwidzi vana ndedzino. Ndiani anomhanya nokukurumidza kupfuura vamwe? (Sonu: 14 sekonzi, Minji: 16 sekonzi, Haeun: 15 sekonzi, Jiho: 18 sekonzi)
hints: Tsvakai mukwikwidzi akatora nguva shoma kumhanya mamita 100 akafanana.
14 sekonzi ndiyo nguva pfupi.
physics-e5-q3.explanation: Nokuti kureba kwekufamba kwakafanana kwakaita se $100\text{ m}$, Sonu ane nguva pfupi ye $14$ sekonzi, saka speed yake yepakati ndiyo yakakura, inenge $7.14\text{ m/s}$.

physics-e5-q4.prompt: Motokari yakapfuura nzvimbo yekutarisa speed yepamugwagwa mukuru (kureba kwose 30 km) mumaminetsi 15. Speed yepakati yemotokari iyi ndeyemakiromita mangani paawa?
hints: Shandurai maminetsi 15 kuita awa.
15 maminetsi = 15/60 awa = 0.25 awa (1/4 awa).
physics-e5-q4.explanation: $15$ maminetsi ndiwo $\frac{15}{60} = 0.25$ awa ($\frac{1}{4}$ awa). Speed yepakati ndi $30\text{ km} \div 0.25\text{ h} = 120\text{ km/h}$.

physics-e5-c.prompt: [Kududzira data yepamusoro] Mu graph yekureba kwekufamba nenguva, 'slope' yemutsetse inomiririra huwandu hwefizikisi ipi, uye chinhu chinofamba sei kana mutsetse uri wakananga une slope yakaenzana?

options.a: Speed — kufamba kunoenderana nespeed yakaenzana (uniform motion)
options.c: Kureba kwekufamba — kufamba kunokurumidza zvishoma nezvishoma

hints: Mu graph, (shanduko yeaxis yakamira ÷ shanduko yeaxis yakarara) = (kureba ÷ nguva).
Kureba ÷ nguva ndiyo speed.
physics-e5-c.explanation: Slope ye graph yenguva-nekureba ndiyo (kureba kwekufamba ÷ nguva), saka inomiririra 'speed', uye mutsetse wakananga une slope yakaenzana unoreva 'uniform motion' ine speed yakaenzana.

physics-e5-q5.prompt: Kana vachifamba kureba kwemakiromita 60 kwakafanana, ndeupi musiyano wenguva pakati pemotokari inoenda ne 60 km paawa nebhazi rinoenda ne 30 km paawa?

options.a: Bhazi rinotora awa imwe yakawanda kupfuura motokari
options.b: Motokari inotora maawa maviri akawanda kupfuura bhazi
options.c: Nguva dzakatorwa nemotokari mbiri dzakaenzana chaizvo
options.d: Bhazi rinotora hafu yeawa yakawanda kupfuura motokari

hints: Shandisai fomula nguva = kureba ÷ speed.
Motokari: 60/60 = awa 1, bhazi: 60/30 = maawa 2
physics-e5-q5.explanation: Motokari inotora $60\text{ km} \div 60\text{ km/h} = 1$ awa, bhazi rinotora $60\text{ km} \div 30\text{ km/h} = 2$ maawa, saka bhazi rinotora awa $1$ yakawanda.

physics-e6-q1.prompt: Tinoda kubatidza mwenje nebhatiri rimwe, mabhaibhi maviri, uye switch zvakabatanidzwa nemawaya. Ndechipi chirevo chakarurama chemamiriro e'closed circuit' unoita kuti mabhaibhi abvire?

options.a: Inofanira kubatanidzwa pasina kutyoka kubva pa pole yeplus (+) yebhatiri, kuburikidza ne switch nemabhaibhi, kusvika pa pole yeminus (-)
options.b: Magumo ose ewaya anofanira kubatanidzwa kupole yeplus (+) yebhatiri chete
options.c: Rabha inofanira kuiswa pakati pewaya kuti iunganidze magetsi
options.d: Switch inofanira kuvhurwa kuti pave nemukaha pakati pewaya

hints: Current inogona kufamba kana waya ichibatana pasina kutyoka.
Mapole eplus (+) neminus (-) ebhatiri anofanira kubatanidzwa zvizere.
physics-e6-q1.explanation: Kuti current ifambe, pane kudiwa closed circuit inobatanidzwa pasina kutyoka kubva papole imwe yebhatiri, kuburikidza nezvikamu zvemagetsi, kusvika papole yakatarisana nayo.

physics-e6-q2.prompt: Ndechipi chirevo chakarurama chekuenzanisa circuit ine mabhaibhi maviri akaenzana akabatanidzwa mu series nemu parallel?

options.a: Mabhaibhi akabatanidzwa mu parallel anopenya kupfuura aya ari mu series
options.b: Mu series, kana bhaibhi rimwe rikabviswa, rimwe rinoramba richivira
options.c: Mu parallel, kana bhaibhi rimwe rikabviswa, rimwe rinodzimwa pakarepo
options.d: Mabhaibhi ari mu series anopenya kapetu kaviri kupfuura ari mu parallel

hints: Fungai kana mumba umwe wamira kubvirwa asi chivanze chichiri kuvira mumba.
Mu parallel, bhaibhi rimwe nerimwe rinowana voltage yose yebhatiri.
physics-e6-q2.explanation: Kana mabhaibhi akabatanidzwa mu parallel, bhaibhi rimwe nerimwe rinowana voltage yose yebhatiri, saka rinopenya zvikuru, uye kana rimwe rikatsemuka, mamwe anoramba achishanda.

physics-e6-q3.prompt: Kana tichitarisa mufananidzo wemuti kana nzvimbo iri kure zvikuru uchishandisa convex lens pascreen, mufananidzo unoonekwa sei?

options.a: Mufananidzo muduku kupfuura chaizvo uye wakadzoserwa kumusoro-pasi nekuruboshwe-kurudyi
options.b: Mufananidzo mukuru kupfuura chaizvo uye wakamira zvakanaka
options.c: Mufananidzo wakaenzana nechaizvo uye wakamira zvakanaka

Chiedza chinopfuura mu lens chinotyoka (refraction) chodyonzwa.
physics-e6-q3.explanation: Kana chinhu chiri kure kupfuura focal length ye convex lens, pascreen pane real image duku kupfuura chaizvo uye yakadzoserwa kumusoro-pasi nekuruboshwe-kurudyi.

physics-e6-q4.prompt: Electromagnet yakagadzirwa nokuputira waya yeenamel katanhatu kaviri pamusoro pemsumari wesimbi ichibatanidzwa nebhatiri. Tingaita sei kuti electromagnet iyi inamire ma clip mazhinji (simba rakawanda)?

options.a: Kubatanidza mamwe mabhatiri mu series kuti current ifambe zvakasimba
options.b: Kuderedza kuputira waya yeenamel kuita katsi makumi maviri
options.d: Kubvisa msumari wesimbi tichiisa chigubhu chemuti

hints: Simba reelectromagnet rinoenderana nesimba recurrent nenhamba yekuputira coil.
Kana current yakasimba, magnetic field inova yakasimba.
physics-e6-q4.explanation: Kuti simba reelectromagnet rikure, wedzerai nhamba yekuputira coil, kana kuwedzera mabhatiri mu series kuti current inofamba mu circuit ikure.

physics-e6-c.prompt: [Kushandisa kwepamusoro] Kana magirazi ekukudza (convex lens) akaswederwa pedyo zvikuru nemagwaro ephepanhau, magwaro anoonekwa makuru uye akamira zvakanaka, asi kana akabviswa kure, magwaro anoonekwa akadzoserwa kumusoro-pasi. Chii chinoita kuti aonekwe akamira zvakanaka paari pedyo?

options.a: Nokuti magwaro ari mukati me focal length ye lens, saka tinoona virtual image yakamira yakakudzwa
options.b: Nokuti chiedza chinoreflect sepagirazi pamusoro pe lens
options.d: Nokuti mhute iri mumhepo yakapisa lens yemagirazi ekukudza

hints: Fungai nzira yechiedza kana chinhu chiri pedyo kupfuura focal length.
Chiedza chinopararira, saka mitsetse inofanira kutambanudzwa kumashure kwe lens kuti isangane.
physics-e6-c.explanation: Kana chinhu chiri mukati me focal length ye convex lens, mitsetse yakatambanudzwa yechiedza chakatyoka inosangana ichigadzira virtual image ine hukuru kupfuura chinhu uye yakamira (magnified upright virtual image).

physics-e6-q5.prompt: Chii chikonzero chesainzi nei zvisingatenderwi kubata plug yemagetsi kana switch yemidziyo yemumba nemaoko akanyorova?

options.a: Nokuti ions dzemaminerari dzakanyungudutswa mumvura dzinoita kuti magetsi apfuure nyore, uye njodzi yekurovererwa nemagetsi inowedzera zvikuru
options.b: Nokuti madonhwe emvura anotonhodza plug ichiita chando
options.c: Nokuti maoko akanyorova anogadzira simba remagineti
options.d: Nokuti magetsi anoita kuti mvura iri pamaoko ipere yose

hints: Mvura yezuva nezuva, kusiyana nemvura yakachena, ine electrolytes dzakanyungudutswa.
Maoko akanyorova anoderedza resistance yeganda zvikuru, saka current inofamba nyore.
physics-e6-q5.explanation: Kana ganda richinyorova, resistance yemagetsi yemuviri inoderera zvakanyanya kuita chikamu chimwe pamakumi echenguva dzose, saka kunyangwe voltage duku inogona kuita current inouraya inopfuura nemuviri, ichiita kurovererwa nemagetsi.

physics-m1-q1.prompt: Muzvino wemuchadenga ane mass ye 60 kg paPasi akasvika pamusoro peMwedzi. Ndechipi chirevo chakarurama pamusoro pe'mass' ne'weight' paMwedzi? (Gravity yeMwedzi i 1/6 yePasi)

options.a: Mass inoramba i 60 kg, weight inoderera ku 1/6 yepaPasi
options.c: Mass inoderera ku 1/6, weight inoramba yakafanana
options.d: Mass neweight zvose zvinowedzera kakumi nenhanhatu
